cases.title: 拒绝后再次进入
steps: Seed PERMISSION_DENIED and configure Android requestable state
Enter Camera: observe no unsolicited repeated permission dialog
User taps retry permission once: observe one platform request
Switch host to non-requestable: retry must not loop; Settings/Gallery/Back remain accessible
assertions: Platform permission re-request happens only on explicit user action AND when Android allows it
No repeated permission requests on navigation or recomposition
Capture stays disabled until actual grant and CameraX Ready

cases.title: 不再询问或受策略限制
steps: Open Camera permission recovery, verify no repeated platform prompt
Tap Open Settings; verify target is current app settings
Return without grant; use Gallery and Back; then grant and recheck permission
assertions: Open Settings action targets this app's Android settings screen
Gallery and Back remain usable while CAMERA denied
No automatic grant inferred from navigating to settings

cases.title: 首次显示的触发条件

Ready 后展示且快门未触发

cases.title: P02 到 P03

cases.title: 上一步回退

cases.title: 模型早于最短节拍完成
steps: 提前发送检测/分类事件

cases.title: 模型延迟返回
steps: Start classifier attempt; capture request ID and monotonic start time
Hold result until before configured deadline: expect still waiting
Advance past approved deadline without result: expect technical failure and explicit Retry
Deliver late old model callback: expect ignored
User taps Retry: expect new attempt ID and fresh deadline
assertions: No RESULT_READY or fish species without real classifier result
Deadline crossing maps to TECHNICAL_FAILURE, never NO_FISH or INVALID
Failed attempt never writes FishRecord and late callback cannot navigate
Retry only on user action and generates new attempt ID

cases.title: 真实无鱼分支
steps: 真实 Detector 输入无鱼图
assertions: 依据 Detector 输出进入 NO_FISH

cases.title: 模型或裁切错误
steps: 分别注入 Detector、Classifier、Crop 异常

cases.title: 高置信结果 UI
steps: 受控 Result 测试输入确定的 HIGH 输出
assertions: 展示 High 状态与正确鱼种，不当作真实模型精度

cases.title: 低置信度人工确认 UI
无鱼结果 UI

cases.title: 严重图像质量异常

assertions: 进入质量异常恢复，文案按照 Copy 合同

cases.title: Result 原图完整且方向正确

assertions: 无拉伸或错误旋转，鱼体安全区域不被裁切

cases.title: Result 首入 CTA 不 Loading
assertions: 只有点击后触发相应 Loading

cases.title: 缺失可选元数据

assertions: 可选字段缺失安全降级、不崩溃

cases.title: 重组不重复识别
steps: 在 Result 触发 Compose 重组/恢复
assertions: 不重复发识别请求、不重复导航或保存

cases.title: Guide 退出状态保持
steps: 未完成 Guide 按 Back

cases.title: Processing 中断/返回策略
steps: Start real Processing with an active request ID
Tap Processing Back and inspect cancellation/invalidation event
Assert destination is Capture camera and record count is zero
Deliver late old request callback; verify ignored; open capture again
assertions: Active inference cancelled or invalidated with attempt ID
Back returns to Capture, not Result or Home
Stale classifier callback ignored; no FishRecord created
Next camera capture can run independently

cases.title: Result 顶部返回目的地
steps: Seed RETURNING and reach unsaved Result from Empty Home
Record pre-back record count and source-home route
Tap top Back and inspect destination/back stack
Reenter camera and verify no stale Result route
assertions: Top Back returns to originating Empty Home for this QA user
If Save was never requested, FishRecord count remains zero
No stale Result stack; next capture starts fresh

cases.title: Result 系统 Back 处理
steps: Reach unsaved Result from Empty Home
Compare destination with NAV-04 and check archive/back stack
assertions: System Back returns same origin Empty Home as top Back
No FishRecord created and no duplicate/back-stack loop

cases.title: 返回后第二次识别
steps: 识别一次返回后再点拍照

cases.title: Activity 重建/后台恢复
steps: Start Processing and capture attempt ID
Background/foreground while attempt owner still active; verify same attempt resumed
Recreate Activity while same attempt can reattach safely; inspect single inference invocation
Lose process/attempt owner; reopen and observe explicit Retry when photo retained or Retake otherwise
Inject stale callback and verify it cannot navigate Result
assertions: When safely alive, resume SAME attempt without a second inference
When not safely recoverable, never silently restart inference or fabricate Result
Offer explicit Retry Recognition with retained image or Retake without it
Stale callback never routes Result or creates FishRecord

cases.title: 基准 API28 主链路
assertions: 截图与轨迹绑定当前 HEAD、APK SHA
